title: The flow's skills give a session opposite orders
what: One answer per question, written once and pointed to from the others; the profile decides models; the orchestrator skill loses ALIX-only wording.
why: Skills disagree, so a session picks by guess: model: for agents (delegate: never unless escalating; sdd skills: pass sonnet); who runs the wave check (parallel-apply: coordinator runs ci; delegate: runner runs relay gate); stop between phases and suggest /clear (openspec-apply-orchestrator section 5) vs never ask for /clear (global rules); max agents 6 (orchestrator) vs 4 (kit.toml, global); bin/packet (orchestrator) vs kit packet; always a research agent (sdd:plan section 2) vs do small work yourself (global delegation); loading the delegate skill before the first agent is not enforced by any hook.
failing_case: Trial log sections 3-4: each conflict above was hit and settled by the coordinator's judgment; under a profile other than active the sdd skills would override the profile's model.
pass_cases: A search for each topic finds one rule and references to it; no two skills state different numbers or orders.
